intro.say: Let's learn how to keep our teeth clean and shiny!

rounds.say: Teeth help us bite and chew our food. We need to keep them clean!
rounds.caption: Teeth bite and chew

rounds.say: Brush your teeth two times a day: in the morning and before bed. Brush for two minutes!
rounds.caption: Morning + night

rounds.ask: What do we use to clean our teeth?

options.label: Broom
options.why: A broom is for the floor.

options.label: Spoon
options.why: A spoon is for eating.

rounds.explain: A toothbrush and toothpaste clean our teeth.

rounds.ask: How many times a day should you brush?

options.why: Once is not enough, brush at night too.
That is too many, 2 times is right.

rounds.explain: Brush 2 times a day, morning and night.

rounds.ask: When is a great time to brush your teeth?

options.label: During football
options.why: You can't brush while playing!

rounds.explain: Brushing before bed cleans away food from the day.

rounds.ask: What do teeth help us do?

options.label: Hear
options.why: We hear with our ears.

options.label: Run
options.why: Legs help us run.

rounds.explain: Teeth bite and chew our food into small pieces.

rounds.ask: Is it good for teeth, or not good?
rounds.explain: Brushing, water and crunchy carrots help, too many sweets do not.

intro.say: Did you know you get two sets of teeth? Let's find out!

rounds.say: Little children have baby teeth. Around age 6, baby teeth get wobbly and fall out.
rounds.caption: Baby teeth fall out

rounds.say: Then bigger adult teeth grow in their place. Adult teeth must last your whole life, so look after them!
rounds.caption: Adult teeth stay

rounds.ask: Why does a wobbly baby tooth fall out?

options.label: Too many sweets
options.why: Baby teeth fall out even in children who brush well.

options.label: You slept
options.why: Sleeping does not make teeth fall out.

rounds.explain: An adult tooth grows underneath and pushes the baby tooth out.

rounds.ask: How many sets of teeth do people get?

options.why: We get more than one set.
That is too many.

rounds.explain: We get baby teeth first, then adult teeth.

rounds.ask: If an adult tooth falls out, does a new one grow?

options.label: Yes
options.why: Sadly, adult teeth do not grow back.

rounds.explain: Adult teeth do not grow back, so we must take good care of them.

rounds.ask: Who helps check that our teeth are healthy?

options.label: Cook
options.why: A cook makes food.

options.label: Firefighter
options.why: Firefighters put out fires.

rounds.explain: A dentist checks and cleans our teeth.

rounds.ask: Put these in order, from first to last.
rounds.explain: Baby teeth wobble, fall out, leave a gap, then an adult tooth grows.

intro.say: Let's be tooth detectives and learn why sugar can hurt teeth.

rounds.say: Tiny germs live in our mouths. When we eat sugar, the germs make acid that can make holes in teeth. These holes are called cavities.
rounds.caption: Sugar + germs = holes

rounds.say: Brushing sweeps germs away. Drinking water and eating crunchy fruit and veg help too. Visit the dentist for a check-up.
rounds.caption: Brush · Water · Dentist

rounds.ask: What do germs make when they eat sugar?

options.label: More sugar
options.why: Germs turn sugar into acid, not more sugar.

options.label: Rainbows
options.why: Germs can't make rainbows!

rounds.explain: Germs make acid, and acid can make holes in teeth.

rounds.ask: Which snack is kinder to your teeth?

options.label: Sweets
options.why: Sweets stay on teeth and feed the germs.

options.label: Doughnut
options.why: Doughnuts are full of sugar.

rounds.explain: Cheese has very little sugar, so it is kinder to teeth.

rounds.ask: Sam brushes for just 5 seconds. What should he do?

options.label: Skip brushing
options.why: Skipping lets germs stay on teeth.

options.label: Eat a sweet
options.why: That would feed the germs.

rounds.explain: Brushing for two minutes cleans every tooth.

rounds.ask: What is the best drink for your teeth?

options.label: Fizzy drink
options.why: Fizzy drinks have sugar and acid.

options.label: Sweet juice
options.why: Sweet juice has lots of sugar.

rounds.explain: Water has no sugar and rinses your mouth.

rounds.ask: Why do we visit the dentist even when teeth do not hurt?

options.label: Get a toy
options.why: That is not the reason.

options.label: Grow new teeth
options.why: The dentist can't grow new teeth.

rounds.explain: The dentist can spot tiny problems before they get big.

rounds.ask: Put the bedtime steps in order.
rounds.explain: Brush after your last food, then get into bed and sleep.
